project.dashboard.title: Projects
project.dashboard.description: Everything you host, grouped by the organization that owns it.
project.dashboard.emptyDesc: A project holds the services that ship together - an app and the static site in front of it, say. Open one and you can add the first service straight after.
project.overview.archivedNotice: This project is archived. Its services are stopped and nothing was deleted - restore it from Settings to start them again.
project.overview.servicesCardDesc: Intent is what you asked for; the pill is what the node last reported.
project.settings.title: Settings
project.settings.descWritable: What this project is called, and what happens to it.
project.settings.descReadOnly: You have read access to this organization, so these controls are off.
project.rename.title: Name
project.rename.description: What this project is called in the switcher and on the dashboard.
project.rename.name: Name
project.rename.descHint: Shown under the name on the dashboard.
project.rename.addressNote: Address: /{slug}. It cannot be changed - something is always still pointing at the old one.
project.lifecycle.archivedDesc: Nothing in this project is running. Restore it and the services come back stopped.
project.lifecycle.activeDesc: Archiving stops everything and deletes nothing. Deleting removes the project and {services}.
project.lifecycle.confirmDeleteBody: This removes the project and {services} in it. Volume data stays on the node until it is purged, and nothing else about this can be undone.
project.lifecycle.readOnlyNotice: Deleting a project is an owner or admin decision. A developer may break a service and should not be able to remove the folder holding six of them.
project.create.title: New project
project.create.description: A project groups the services that ship together and share an address book.
project.create.noOrgs: You are not a member of an organization yet. Accept an invitation, or open one from the Organizations screen, and a project can go in it.
project.create.name: Name
project.create.slugDerivedHint: Leave it empty and the address becomes "{slug}".
project.create.slugRule: Use {min} to {max} characters: lower-case letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter or a digit.
project.create.descHint: Optional. What this project is for, for whoever joins next.
project.newService.title: New service
project.newService.description: Adding to {name}. The kind cannot be changed afterwards; everything else can.
project.newService.archivedNotice: This project is archived. Restore it from Settings before adding a service.
project.newService.readOnlyNotice: You have read access to this organization, so this form is off.
project.newService.name: Name
project.newService.slugDerivedHint: Leave it empty and the address becomes "{slug}". It cannot be changed later.
project.newService.containerDesc: What the node runs, and how it keeps it running.
project.newService.sourceDescSite: A site is built from a repository, and the build produces the directory the node serves.
project.newService.sourceDescApp: Optional for an app: how your code gets into a language-runtime image.
project.newService.limitsDesc: Enforced by the node through cgroups.
